blocks.html: CryptPad is your team's secure, end-to-end encrypted collaboration suite. This guide gets you signed in and creating your first document.

slides.title: Welcome to CryptPad
slides.html: CryptPad is a secure, end-to-end encrypted collaboration suite. Your team can create and collaboratively edit documents and share files securely. This Deploy App server runs your team's own, decentralized CryptPad service.

slides.title: Why CryptPad is secure
slides.html: CryptPad ensures that not even the server administrator can read your files. You decide who to share with — other users on this Deploy App server also need an invitation from you to read your files.

slides.title: Sign in with Deploy App
slides.html: CryptPad is integrated with Deploy App's certificate-based authentication. Click Log in to CryptPad and you are authenticated automatically using your Deploy App credentials — no separate account or password is needed.

slides.title: Your CryptPad dashboard
slides.html: After signing in you see your CryptPad dashboard. From here you can create new documents, access recent files, manage your CryptDrive, and collaborate with team members.

slides.title: Create your first document
slides.html: Click the + button on your dashboard to create a new document. Choose from rich text, code, spreadsheets, kanban boards, presentations, whiteboards, forms, and more. All documents are encrypted automatically.

slides.title: Share with your team
slides.html: To share a document, click the share button in the toolbar. Share with specific team members or create a link. Multiple users can edit simultaneously and see each other's changes in real time.
